WITH aug_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS avg_fx_rate_aug
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
    WHERE currency = 'USD' AND period = '2026-08'
)
SELECT
    SUM(pl.qty * pl.unit_price_orig * (pl.fx_rate - aug_avg.avg_fx_rate_aug)) AS fx_impact_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl, aug_avg
WHERE pl.currency = 'USD' AND pl.period = '2026-09'
